title: Project-relative cache-dir allows unrestricted pickle.load of attacker-controlled data
author: aaka3h
body_preview: ### Summary  Black resolves a relative `cache-dir` from `[tool.black]` inside the project checkout and then calls `pickle.load()` on files under that path. Both the metadata cache and the grammar caches are affected.  A repo author can drop crafted pickle files with the expected names. If someone later runs Black on that checkout with caching enabled, the process deserializes them.  This was also...

title: Force-excluded stdin input is not echoed back unchanged
author: jiteshgulati
